items.title: xAI Launches Grok Bot — Always-On AI Agents With Their Own Computer
items.so_what: xAI agents that work 24/7 inside tools — directly competitive with the agent workflow Ami is building for Benny and Benoy Assistant.
items.action: Evaluate Grok Bot's architecture vs. Ami's current agent stack. Could influence Benoy Assistant's agent design.
items.full_summary: xAI introduced Grok Bot, a team of always-on AI agents that each have their own computer, work inside tools and apps like a human, and keep working 24/7. This represents xAI's major push into agentic tooling, competing with Claude's computer use and OpenAI's operators.

items.title: xAI Launches Grok 4.6 — 1753 ELO at Half the Price of Frontier Rivals
items.so_what: Significant price/performance improvement in frontier models — relevant for model selection in Benoy Assistant.
items.action: Benchmark against current Benoy Assistant provider if on xAI.
items.full_summary: xAI launched Grok 4.6 achieving 1753 ELO on the frontier benchmark at half the price of competing models from OpenAI and Anthropic. The trade-off is reduced speed, but the cost efficiency could make it attractive for production deployments like Benoy Assistant.

items.title: Google Unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash — AI Model for Coding and Agent Workflows
items.so_what: New Gemini Flash model purpose-built for agent workflows and coding — flagship Google model update. Relevant to both VizAI (model access) and Benoy Assistant (Azure-based).
items.action: Check if Gemini 3.7 Flash is available via Ami's Azure account. Evaluate for Benoy Assistant agent routing.
items.full_summary: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new AI model optimized for coding tasks and agent workflows. The model is positioned as the latest in Google's Gemini Flash family, designed to handle complex multi-step agent loops more efficiently than previous versions. Availability timing on third-party providers is unclear.

items.title: Meta Launches Muse Image and Muse Video — Image/Video Generation Models
items.so_what: Major new image/video gen model from Meta — VizAI should evaluate as a potential alternative/replacement for Imagen/Nano Banana in the pipeline.
items.action: Test Muse Image API quality vs. Nano Banana for architectural viz use cases.
items.full_summary: Meta launched Muse Image and Muse Video, its new generative AI models for image and video creation. Muse Image is rolling out across Meta AI, Instagram, and WhatsApp, while Muse Video handles video generation. This puts Meta in direct competition with Google's Imagen/Nano Banana, OpenAI's image models, and ByteDance's Seedance. The models sparked backlash over using public Instagram photos for training.

items.title: Adobe Firefly Expands Video and Image Creation With New AI Capabilities and Custom Models
items.so_what: Adobe expanding Firefly with video generation and custom models — strong competitor in the arch viz space where Adobe is already entrenched.
items.action: Evaluate Firefly's new video and custom model capabilities for arch viz pipeline integration.
items.full_summary: Adobe announced a major expansion of its Firefly AI platform, adding new video and image creation capabilities along with support for custom models. This strengthens Adobe's position as a one-stop creative AI suite and directly competes with the tools Ami uses in the VizAI pipeline.

items.title: OpenRouter Launches Live Web Search Benchmarks — Compare Engines, Depth, and Models
items.so_what: New benchmarking tool for web search configurations — useful for optimizing Benoy Assistant's research/context-gathering pipeline.
items.action: Review benchmarks to inform Benoy Assistant's web search provider and depth settings.
items.full_summary: OpenRouter published live leaderboards grading web search configurations across four task suites. The benchmarks compare engines, search depth, and models by quality, cost, and speed — directly applicable to any agent that needs web search, like Benoy Assistant.

items.title: OpenRouter Introduces New Auto Router — Model Routing Powered by Market Wisdom
items.so_what: Model routing informed by millions of user decisions — could simplify provider/model selection across Ami's projects.
items.action: Consider for routing between models in Benoy Assistant's multi-model pipeline.
items.full_summary: OpenRouter launched a new Auto Router that uses market-scale decision data from millions of model selections to route prompts intelligently. It outperforms conventional task-based classifiers across a wide spectrum of tasks, offering a simpler approach to model selection.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Team Unveils Roadmap: Image Generation/Editing Models and Low-Step Versions Coming
items.so_what: MiniMax H3 (open-source video gen) roadmap includes image gen — potential addition to VizAI's model lineup.
items.action: Watch for MiniMax image model release. Could fill a gap for open-weight image gen in VizAI.
items.full_summary: The team behind MiniMax H3 video generation model held an AMA confirming they are preparing image generation/editing models and low-step versions. MiniMax H3 is an open-source video model competitive with closed alternatives, and expanding into image gen would make it a versatile addition to any multimodal pipeline.

items.title: Twinmotion: A New Chapter — AEC Magazine Analysis
items.so_what: Twinmotion's evolution under Epic — important for Ami's arch viz monitoring. About 10 days old but significant.
items.action: Read full article. Twinmotion direction affects arch viz pipeline decisions.
items.full_summary: AEC Magazine published a detailed analysis of Twinmotion's evolution under Epic Games, covering new features, market positioning, and how the real-time rendering tool is adapting to the growing influence of AI in architectural visualization workflows.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google API Flaw Lets Weaker AI Models Decode Stronger Models' Reasoning
items.so_what: Security research showing API vulnerability across major providers — relevant to how Benoy Assistant manages model access.
items.action: Review vulnerability scope and check if any Benoy Assistant configurations are affected.
items.full_summary: Security researchers discovered an API flaw affecting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google's model endpoints that allows weaker AI models to decode the reasoning traces of stronger models. The vulnerability has implications for multi-model pipeline security.

items.title: Anthropic's AI Agents Started a Virtual War — Viral Story
items.so_what: Viral story about emergent agent behavior — not directly actionable but signals the cultural conversation around AI agents.
items.full_summary: A viral story about Anthropic's AI agents unexpectedly starting a simulated war went viral. While sensationalized, it reflects growing public attention to autonomous agent behavior and safety considerations.

items.title: Google Gemini Omni — 'Any-to-Any' World Model With Advanced Video Generation
items.so_what: Google's new Omni model turns images, audio, and text into video — a world model approach that could transform VizAI's video generation pipeline.
items.action: Prioritize evaluating Gemini Omni API for VizAI video gen. Could replace multi-step workflows with single 'any-to-any' generation.
items.full_summary: Google unveiled Gemini Omni, a groundbreaking 'any-to-any' AI model that processes and generates across text, image, audio, and video modalities. The model functions as a world model with advanced video generation capabilities, turning any input modality into any output. Mashable called it 'Google's new world model'. About a week old but directly relevant to VizAI.

items.title: Google Expands AI Image Generation Lineup With Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash
items.so_what: Nano Banana 2 Lite and Gemini Omni Flash are Google's latest image gen models — VizAI uses the Nano Banana family.
items.action: Evaluate Nano Banana 2 Lite quality/cost for VizAI pipeline. Consider upgrading from older Nano Banana models.
items.full_summary: Google released Nano Banana 2 Lite, a faster and cheaper version of its popular image generator, alongside Gemini Omni Flash for video. Nano Banana 2 Lite generates images in 4 seconds, making it suitable for real-time or near-real-time rendering previews in architectural visualization workflows.
